arms.spline: manifold arm (smoothing spline, its OWN end state; differs from the chord's by the sagitta)
arms.spline_matched: spline arm bent onto the chord's end state (the spline initialiser)
arms.geo_{knn,kde}_from_{chord,spline}: Eq. 4 minimiser under G_E, 50 free nodes, fixed chord endpoints, resampled to 50 waypoints uniform in arc length
arms.geo_knnall_from_chord: kNN energy fit on knot clips at ALL values (the held-out arc's values included; probe/test never), from the chord
arms.geo_knn_spline_end: kNN geodesic pinned to the SPLINE arm's own end state (spline init)
arms.flat_from_spline: same optimiser with G = I from the spline initialiser (parity: must be the chord)
